lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows, with increased density and reduced diameter moving anteriorly toward the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity align with the centroids of the white blobs, creating a grid-like matrix on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, marked by a high-contrast transition from light-reflected pixels on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side of the ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple elongated, dark-toned organisms (remoras) attached to the posterior edge and underside of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High density of commensal fish (teleosts) occluding parts of the lower flank and ventral region; significant grain and chromatic aberration across the image sensor.
